name: Bottlecap
description: Inhabits data storage augments and protects specific files from corruption — not all files, just ones it has determined are important to the user.
observed_behavior: Creates redundant copies of emotionally significant data — photos, voice recordings, messages from the dead. Other files may corrupt normally.
story_hooks: A grieving partner discovers that every recording of their dead lover's voice has been preserved in perfect fidelity while everything else degraded
